title: The Future of Potions?
description:
You feel a faint rumbling as you round the corner to discover a gigantic spinning apparatus!
It has several slots which appear to convert liquids into a highly compressed digestible tablet.

The idea of turning these health tonics into a tiny morsel is uncomfortable but perhaps it's good to try new things?

options.title: Insert [potion rarity] Potion
options.description: Lose [gold][your potion][/gold]. Obtain an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] [gold][matching rarity] [random card type][/gold].

conditions: All players must have at least 2 potions
notes:
This event generates options dynamically based on your potions. You can perform this conversion up to 3 times (or once per potion, whichever is fewer). Each option allows you to sacrifice one of your potions to receive an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card.

[gold]Card Rarity[/gold]: The generated card's rarity matches your potion's rarity (Common/Token potions → Common cards, Uncommon → Uncommon, Rare/Event → Rare).

[gold]Card Type[/gold]: The card type is randomly selected from Attack, Skill, or Power. However, Common and Token potions can only generate Attack or Skill cards—never Power.

[gold]Automation[/gold]: All generated cards are automatically [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
